name: A King's Tribute
summary: King Magni Bronzebeard has commissioned a monument to Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who perished defending the Thandol Span. To honor the fallen warrior with enduring dignity, Grand Mason Marblesten dispatches travelers to Hillsbrad to retrieve pristine Alterac Granite.

sections.title: A Royal Commission
sections.body: When King Magni Bronzebeard decided that fallen soldier Sully Balloo deserved a lasting memorial, the task fell directly to Ironforge's finest craftsman, Grand Mason Marblesten. Balloo lost his life during the disaster at the Thandol Span, a vital artery connecting the dwarven lands to northern kingdoms that has suffered brutal attacks by Dark Iron saboteurs. To Marblesten, fulfilling the king's royal decree means creating a sculpture that will withstand both time and war, ensuring that dwarven sacrifice is neither overlooked nor forgotten in the Great Forge.

sections.title: Stone of the North
sections.body: A master dwarven mason will not settle for ordinary quarry rock for a king's project. Marblesten insists that Sully Balloo's likeness can only be captured in Alterac Granite, a dense, resilient stone prized for its durability and clean texture. The challenge lies in securing it: the best deposits lie around Darrow Hill within the contested foothills of Hillsbrad. Venturing deep into the troubled north is dangerous, but dwarven stonework demands materials worthy of the heroism they commemorate.

faq.answer: Sully Balloo was an Alliance soldier who died defending the Thandol Span during its catastrophic sabotage. Struck by his bravery and the letter retrieved from his body, King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a permanent statue erected in his honor.

Grand Mason Marblesten is the master sculptor and stoneworker of Ironforge. Operating out of the city's Commons, he handles royal commissions and takes fierce pride in working with only the finest regional stones.

Alterac Granite is celebrated across the Eastern Kingdoms for its exceptional density, fine grain, and endurance against erosion. Marblesten insists that only stone of this caliber is worthy of a royal tribute that will last through the ages.
Darrow Hill is a hilly area in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, just below the Headland and near the border of Alterac, where Alterac Granite is found in the caves.

faq.q: What happened at the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: The Thandol Span, the colossal bridge spanning the chasm between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands, suffered an assault by Dark Iron saboteurs who planted explosives to cut Alliance supply routes, claiming many defenders' lives.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the granite to Marblesten?
faq.answer: Once supplied with the Alterac Granite, Marblesten completes the memorial and asks you to report to King Magni that it is finished.

angles.text: Honoring Sully Balloo touches the heart of dwarven culture, where stonework, martial sacrifice, and steadfast loyalty to King Bronzebeard are deeply intertwined.
Miners understand Marblesten's selective eye; the hard, unyielding veins of Alterac Granite require seasoned hands to extract cleanly without fracturing.
Securing materials from Hillsbrad reinforces the Alliance presence in the fractured north while honoring an ordinary soldier who gave his life for the common cause.
